def read_writer_config(config_files, loader=UnsafeLoader):
    """Read the writer `config_files` and return the info extracted."""
    conf = {}

                         "'{}'".format(writer_configs))

The `MITIFFWriter` in `satpy` was adding the pixel size to the `x_0` and `y_0` values in the projection string by default. This caused geo-location discrepancies in some cases. I have added a configuration option `add_pixel_size` to the `MITIFFWriter` to allow users to disable this behavior.

The fix involves:
1.  Modifying `satpy/writers/mitiff.py` in the `_append_projection_center` method.
2.  Retrieving the `add_pixel_size` option from `self.info`, defaulting to `True` to maintain backward compatibility.
3.  Using this option to conditionally add the pixel size to the `x_0` and `y_0` calculations.

A reproduction script was used to verify that the projection string is correctly generated both when `add_pixel_size` is `True` (default) and when it is `False`.
